title: Comfortable at every text size · 0.4.2
description: Lumen now follows your text size everywhere, reads clearly with VoiceOver and explains errors in plain words.
notes: Buttons and icons grow with your text size, up to the largest accessibility sizes, and stay tappable.
VoiceOver names every control, announces pinned and selected chats, and hints at touch-and-hold options.
Clearer messages: a refused API key says what to check, wherever it appears; a retired model asks you to choose another.
An empty chat explains how to connect a provider when none is set up.
Attachment chips show a photo icon for photos.
